drafted_from: workflow:combine-several-ai-answers's row in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (its input schema, steps and submit shapes)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:combine-several-ai-answers on the question: should a one-shop bakery add online pre-orders? Here are three answers from three different AIs."
no_lists_because: It reads the answers you paste in and writes one combined answer; it keeps no list.
instructions: 1. Paste the question and at least two answers, each with where it came from.
2. Say "Run workflow:combine-several-ai-answers" with question and answers.

3. The AI works collect, claims, agree-and-differ, check and answer: every claim is pulled out, answers resting on the same source count once, each disagreement gets the assumption that differs, and disputed claims are checked or marked unchecked.
4. Read the one answer: what holds and how many independent answers support it, what is disputed, what no answer established.

worked_examples.title: Two answers on one source count as one
worked_examples.ask: Combine these three answers on pre-orders.

input.question: Should a one-shop bakery add online pre-orders?
answers: run-1: Yes. Pre-orders cut weekend waste, per a trade article. Walk-in sales will not drop.
run-2: Yes. Pre-orders cut weekend waste, per the same trade article. Add a 30% revenue lift.
run-3: Yes. Pre-orders cut waste. Walk-in sales may drop because most customers live nearby.

worked_examples.given: The claims step found: all three say pre-orders cut waste (run-1 and run-2 both rest on the same trade article); only run-2 claims a 30% revenue lift; run-1 says walk-in sales will not drop while run-3 says they may. Read from the agree-and-differ step of the workflow row.
worked_examples.hands_back: The submit shape of step agree-and-differ: {"agreements":[{"claim":"Pre-orders cut weekend waste","independent_count":2}],"single_source_claims":["Pre-orders add a 30% revenue lift"],"disagreements":[{"topic":"Whether walk-in sales drop","differing_assumption":"run-1 assumes the shop sits on a busy street; run-3 assumes most customers live nearby and would switch to ordering ahead"}]}
